messages.text: Succinctly explain the ritual use of blue lotus.

Blue lotus (Nymphaea caerulea) has been used in ritual and spiritual practices for its calming, mildly psychoactive properties. Traditionally, it was used by ancient Egyptians to induce states of relaxation, enhance meditation, promote vivid dreams, and deepen spiritual connection. It is often prepared as a tea, tincture, or smoked to elevate consciousness, stimulate intuition, and support emotional balance. The plant is associated with divine insight and transformation, commonly seen as a symbol of rebirth and enlightenment in many spiritual contexts.
